hints.title: Length and Shift Requirement
hints.text: If s and t have different lengths, conversion is impossible. Otherwise, compute shift (ord(t[i]) - ord(s[i])) % 26.

hints.title: Reusing Shifts Across Rounds
hints.text: A shift d can only be used on move d, d + 26, d + 52, and so on. Track how many times each shift d from 1 to 25 is required.

hints.title: Maximum Move Bound
hints.text: For a shift d needed c times, the largest move required is d + 26 * (c - 1). If this exceeds k for any shift, return false.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating move by move up to k = 10^9 takes O(k) which causes extreme timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting 26 shift frequencies in O(N) time and O(1) space checks feasibility instantly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes the 26-modular round formula d + 26 * (count - 1).
